description:
The unsigned calldata to redeem `shares` (a decimal or 'all') of `vault` for `account`: requestRedeem(shares, account),
        the cohort it joins and when it pays, the cancelRedeem calldata. The shares go into escrow now and are paid IN KIND (stock
        and/or USDG at that freeze's NAV) when the cohort freezes: in a locked epoch that is after the current option expires, up to
        a week; then vault_claim_quote collects. You send it with the account's own owner key; this server never sends.
name: vault_redeem_quote
